description: Fetch a BCA entity dossier (chain, project, person or ticker): name, kind, ticker, chain, website and X handle, summary when there is one, mention count and first and last mention dates. Provide exactly one of slug or ticker. Aliases in slug form resolve to the canonical entity ('cz' to changpeng-zhao, 'maker' to makerdao) and the answer names the alias it came from. The ticker form returns every entity that matches the ticker (the ticker dossier and the chain or project it maps to) and needs an API key; the slug form works without one. Many dossiers are still thin: meta.status partial, with meta.diagnostic.missing naming what is absent (summary, mentions). Use this after search_news surfaces a name, or when the user asks 'what is X' or 'who is X'.

slug.description: Entity slug or a known alias in slug form (e.g. 'vitalik-buterin', 'ethereum', 'cz').

ticker.description: Ticker symbol (e.g. 'ETH', 'SOL'), case-insensitive. Needs an API key: the demo key covers the slug form only.

name: get_entity
